title: Resource and shader packs
note: Pack-name signatures. Pack names are user-controlled, so these are suspicious at most; content-based X-ray detection is the built-in heuristic SSME-H-XRAY_TEXTURES.

rules.name: X-ray shader pack
rules.description: A shader pack whose name contains "xray" is installed. X-ray shaders discard terrain fragments so ores show through blocks.
rules.falsePositives: Pack names are user-controlled; a pack may be mis-named or unused.
rules.limitations: Only the name is checked; shader programs are not interpreted.
